subject: How can I get rid of background calls?

messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: How can I get rid of background calls?
parts:
Hi all

I need to take some measurements from the attached Common Rosefinch recording. It seems dfreq() will enable me to take things like maximum frequency etc. However I need to remove a singing Wren from the recording. I have attached the song of the Common Rosefinch. Also attached is a spectrogram showing the location of the singing Wren. 

Is there a way to remove the Wren from the recording in seewave?

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] How can I get rid of background calls?
parts:
Hi,
You can first try to remove the low frequency noise with the function fir().
And then you can try to remove the Wren (?) syllable using the
argument 'clip' of the function dfreq().
But seewave will not do miracles if you have too noisy samples.
Best regards,
Jerome
